name: Power profile: 8 s, 30 s, 1 min, 5 min
description: All-out efforts to fill in the short end of your power curve: 3 sprints of 8 s, then 30 s, 1 min and 5 min, shortest first, with long easy rolls between. Slope mode on purpose: ERG would cap a sprint. Pick the gear yourself, aiming for 100-120 rpm at the top of each sprint. Ride it fresh, not the day after legs or a hard ride.

messages.text: Power profile today: 3 sprints, then 30 s, 1 min and 5 min.
Every effort is all-out. The rolls between are truly easy.
Slope mode: you pick the gear, the effort is all yours.
Sprints: aim to top out at 100 to 120 rpm. Shift up if you spin out.
Is the FR970 recording? Start it now if not.

steps.label: Opener
steps.text: About FTP on the power card

messages.text: Two minutes at about FTP. Wake the legs up.
Practice jump {rep} of {of}. About 80%, find your gear.
First sprint in 20 seconds. Roll at 80 rpm in a big gear.
Sprint {rep} of {of}. Go! Everything!

steps.label: Easy roll
steps.text: Easy gear, let it come back

messages.text: Easy gear. Breathe. Nearly 5 minutes to the next one.
Sprints done. Next: 30 seconds all-out.
Next sprint in 20 seconds. Roll at 80 rpm, big gear.
30 seconds all-out in 20 seconds. Seated start.

steps.label: 30 s max
steps.text: All-out, hold on to the end

messages.text: 30 seconds. Go hard from the start.
Hold on! Don't let the cadence die.
Good. Easy 5 and a half minutes. Next: 1 minute.
The 1 minute: hard from the start, but not a sprint.
1 minute all-out in 20 seconds.

steps.label: 1 min max
steps.text: Hard, not a sprint. Empty it at the end

messages.text: 1 minute. Strong, steady, not a sprint.
Halfway. Stay on it.
15 seconds. Empty the tank!
Done. 8 easy minutes before the last one.
The 5 minutes: first minute a notch under what you think you can hold.
Then build. The last minute is everything you have left.
5 minutes all-out in 20 seconds. Last effort.
5 minutes. Settle in, a notch under your best.
One minute in. Hold it steady.
Halfway. If it feels OK, lift it a little.
Last minute. Everything now!
15 seconds! Empty it!
That's the test. Easy spin, then save the ride.
Your new bests show on the ride page and in the Training power curve.
